四级核心词汇 · 16英文原文

The Bell Outside the Burned Barn

烧毁的谷仓外那只铃 · 599 词 · 7 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A forest fire reached a farm on the southeast edge of a district. Its owner, Ela, moved her cow and two goats to a field below the road. Smoke stung her eyes and made her choke. When she counted the animals, her tame donkey was missing. She wanted to dash back for him. A fire marshal restrained her. An old can of petrol beside the barn could explode if the flames reached it.

2The crew put out the fire by midday. A column of smoke hung over the yard. Ash buried the crew's footprints. A worker found a crushed pipe near the coal shed. The heat melted its seal. A neighbor speculated that someone had dropped lit tobacco there. Ela thought that was a serious accusation. The marshal asked everyone to refrain from spreading the rumor. It could arouse suspicion of an innocent person. An inquiry into the cause would proceed separately. Their urgent concern was to find the donkey without exposing anyone to the poisonous smoke.

3They found a paw print by a fence and a claw mark on a beam. Neither belonged to a donkey. A frightened dog crept out and licked Ela's hand. Its belly was black with soot. She put it in a spare cage until the vet could examine it. A goat had begun to shiver in the field. Even the dog would startle at a bang. The vet said the animals needed a quiet place to recover. The owner of a nearby farm offered a shed.

4A boy from that farm heard a bell beyond the hill. The sound seemed to come from the opposite slope. A gust could drown it out. The boy waited for the wind to ease, then heard it again. Ela had once thought the echo was a nuisance. Now she used it to narrow the search. A marshal followed a trail where two posts had fallen. He found the donkey confined between a fallen branch and a fence. Its fear was obvious. Its back leg seemed to be caught in a loop of wire.

5Ela's first impulse was to thrust her arm through the gap and pull. The vet asked her to wait. The animal could kick or swallow dirt in its panic. A wire cutter could free it. They had no need to resort to force. Ela took the spare bell from her coat and shook it in the familiar rhythm. The donkey turned toward her. For a moment it stopped pulling. The vet cut the loop and the marshal dragged the wire aside.

6A reporter called the rescue a miracle. Ela knew how close it had been to a tragedy. She had been ready to obey an impulse that would have put more people in danger. The fire marshal asked the district to map its shelters and enforce rules for access. A farmer offered a truck as a shared resource. They also arranged to dispose of burned fuel and clear a vital path beside each barn.

7The next spring, a pupil asked Ela what she remembered most. She thought of the terror she had felt when the bell went silent. For weeks it had returned in her nightmares. She also remembered her hospitable neighbor, who had offered an empty shed. The pupil recorded the tale in a journal. Then he hung a bell by the new gate, within sight of the farm road. Ela asked him to record who could open the gate if she was away. The point was to make the next rescue easier, even if no one felt brave enough to rush in.

四级核心词汇 · 16中文译文

烧毁的谷仓外那只铃

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一场森林大火烧到了片区东南边的一家农场。农场主人埃拉把一头奶牛和两只山羊赶到公路下方的田里。烟刺得她眼疼，也呛得她直咳。清点牲口时，她发现那头温顺的驴不见了。她想冲回去找，消防指挥员拦住了她。谷仓旁还放着一旧罐汽油，火烧到那里就可能爆炸。

2到了中午，队员扑灭了火。一股烟仍飘在院子上空，灰烬盖住了队员的脚印。有人在煤棚旁发现一截压坏的管子，密封处被烤化了。一位邻居猜测，是有人把点着的烟草掉在了那里。埃拉觉得这个指控很重。指挥员请大家别传，免得无辜的人受到怀疑。起火原因会另行调查。眼下最急的是找到驴，同时避免有人接触有毒的烟。

3他们在围栏旁找到一个爪印，又在横梁上发现一道爪痕，两样都不是驴留下的。一条受惊的狗慢慢爬出来，舔了舔埃拉的手。它肚子上全是黑灰。埃拉把它放进备用笼里，等兽医来检查。田里的一只羊已经发抖，就连那条狗听见砰的一声也会吓一跳。兽医说，动物需要找个安静的地方缓过来。附近的农场主人愿意腾出一个棚子。

4那家农场的男孩听见山那头有铃声，声音似乎来自对面山坡。一阵风就可能把它盖住。男孩等风小了，又听见一次。埃拉原先嫌这里的回声烦人，现在反而用它缩小了找寻范围。一位消防人员沿着倒了两根柱子的小路找过去，发现驴被困在断树枝和围栏之间。它显然很害怕，一条后腿好像还套在铁丝圈里。

5埃拉第一反应是把胳膊伸进缺口去拉，兽医请她等等。驴慌起来可能踢人，也可能吞进泥土。铁丝剪能把它放出来，用不着硬拉。埃拉从外套里摸出备用铃，按驴熟悉的节奏摇了摇。驴转过头来，有一会儿停住了挣扎。兽医剪开铁丝圈，消防人员把铁丝拖开。

6记者说这次救援像奇迹，埃拉却知道差一点就会酿成悲剧。她一度想听从冲动闯进去，那会让更多人陷入危险。消防指挥员请片区把动物避难棚画在地图上，也落实进入这些地点的规则。一位农人愿意把卡车拿出来大家共用。他们还安排处理烧过的燃料，清出每座谷仓旁一条要紧的通路。

7第二年春天，有个学生问埃拉，她最记得什么。她想起铃声突然没了时的恐惧。好几个星期，这一幕都会出现在噩梦里。她也记得那位热心的邻居，曾腾出空棚帮她安置牲口。学生把故事记进日记，又在新门旁挂了只从乡间公路上能看见的铃。埃拉请他记下，自己不在时谁能开门。这样，下次就算谁也不敢贸然冲进去，救援还是能更顺利。
